Communications processor CP 1543-1 for connection of SIMATIC S7-1500 to Industrial Ethernet; TCP/IP, ISO, UDP, S7 communication, IP broadcast/ multicast, security (VPN, firewall), diagnostics, SNMPv1/v3, DHCP, FTP client/server, email, IPv4/IPv6, IEEE 802.1X (radius), time synchronization via NTP, 1x RJ45 (10/100/1000 Mbps).

6ES7518-3TT10-0AB0
The CPU 1518T-3 PN (6ES7518-3TT10-0AB0) is not compatible with the predecessor CPUs
with regard to the replacement parts. Therefore, it is not possible to use a SIMATIC Memory
Card from a predecessor CPU directly in the current CPU. If you want to replace a predecessor
CPU with the current CPU, you have to replace the CPU in the TIA project using the "Replace
device" function.
If you use the PROFIBUS interface in your project, you require an additional PROFIBUS
module. The CPU only has PROFINET interfaces.
